# HGN Bathrooms

> Expert bathroom renovations, wet rooms, plumbing and tiling across Surrey, Kent and Sussex. Run by Haydn Nebbeling. 5-star rated, fully insured. Free no-obligation quotes.

## About

HGN Bathrooms is a professional bathroom renovation company based in Lingfield, Surrey, serving homeowners across Surrey, Kent and Sussex. Founded by Haydn Nebbeling, we specialise in complete bathroom renovations from design to finish, including full strip-outs, tiling, plumbing, wet room installations, cloakroom renovations and utility room fit-outs.

## Services

- Full Bathroom Renovations: Complete strip-out and rebuild, tiling, plumbing, finishing
- Wet Room Installation: Waterproof tanking, walk-in showers, modern drainage
- Plumbing Services: Boiler connections, radiators, Quooker taps, pipework
- Tiling & Wall Panelling: Floor-to-ceiling tiling, feature walls, wood slat panelling
- Cloakroom & En-Suite: Small space bathroom design and renovation
- Utility Room Fit-Out: Plumbing, drainage, cabinetry and flooring

## Service Areas

Surrey: Guildford, Woking, Epsom, Reigate, Dorking, Cranleigh, Caterham, Warlingham, Woldingham, Coulsdon
Kent: Sevenoaks, Tonbridge, Tunbridge Wells, Maidstone, Ashford, Edenbridge
Sussex: East Grinstead, Crawley, Horsham, Haywards Heath, Brighton, Forest Row, Copthorne
